blocks.x: Here’s another song you made reference to in an interview. “Let It Come Down” is from a line in Shakespeare.
Yeah. Let it Come Down” is...
And Paul Bowles wrote a book, Let It Come Down. That was another book he recommended to me.
Which Shakespeare play is it from?
I’m trying to think of which play...
